stories.title: 9 policemen killed in terrorist attack in Balochistan
Nato showcases big arms deals as Trump sulks
"Truth will win": Candace Owens mocks Erika Kirk's tears as Tyler Robinson hearing begins in Utah
stories.summary: Candace Owens criticized the Tyler Robinson hearing as it began in Utah, calling it a "show trial" and questioning the prosecution's evidence. She mocked Charlie Kirk's widow, Erika Kirk, and accused her supporters of pushing an emotional narrative. Prosecutors presented DNA evidence, witness testimony and video related to Charlie Kirk's 2025 killing. Judge Tony Graf will decide whether the case has enough evidence to proceed to trial.

stories.title: 9 Indian ships with over 190 seafarers still near Hormuz
What happened to Sur Ronster? Team shares update after e-bike YouTuber’s shocking Ultra Bee crash
stories.summary: Sur Ronster is recovering after what his team called the worst crash of his career while testing a Sur Ron Ultra Bee e-bike. The update came through his official TikTok account, which confirmed he can read fans’ comments while recovering. No injury details or return date have been released. The news comes months after his Sydney Harbour Bridge controversy.

stories.title: 'It got Rs 160 crore from TMC’: ED searches Kolkata company over aircraft deal
stories.summary: Enforcement Directorate searched five locations in Kolkata Tuesday. The agency is probing an aviation firm's alleged financial dealings. Carewell Aviation reportedly received Rs 160 crore from TMC funds. This money was allegedly used to purchase an aircraft and a helicopter. The ED is investigating the unlawful collection and routing of these suspected funds.

stories.title: CBI chargesheets 7 in RCFL bank fraud case
4 states ink pact on decades-long Narmada project payment dispute
4 officials from environment minister Bhupender Yadav's office removed
stories.summary: Four officials from Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav's office were removed on July 3. Amar Singh, a private secretary, was removed on administrative grounds. Political appointees Siddharth Yadav and Ayush Saran had their appointments terminated. Shailesh Kumar Singh was prematurely repatriated to his parent cadre. The ministry has not provided specific reasons for these abrupt removals.

stories.title: Mizkif releases “Emiru Lied, Part 1” video presenting evidence amid defamation lawsuit
stories.summary: Streamer Mizkif shared his side of a legal dispute with Emiru. He presented messages and conversations to support his claims in the lawsuit. Mizkif addressed allegations about their past relationship and subsequent interactions. He also discussed claims of him trying to follow Emiru after their breakup. The legal battle between the two streamers continues with new information emerging.

stories.title: Indian-origin motel manager arrested in Los Angeles for profiting off prostitution, sex-trafficking
After govt notice, Meta details child safety steps
stories.summary: Meta revealed new child safety measures after an Indian government notice regarding Instagram ads. The company disabled numerous offending accounts and s using advanced artificial intelligence tools. Meta stated its systems detect suspicious off-platform links and other exploitation signals. Globally, over four million accounts were removed last year for suspicious child-related activity. The company continues to invest in technology and work with law enforcement agencies.

stories.title: 2018 murder of newborn in California: Bakshinderpal Sing Mann, father who buried baby and then fled to Canada, finally sentenced
Kai Cenat’s first stream in nine months tops 1 million viewers with Streamer University 2026 reveal
stories.summary: Kai Cenat returned to livestreaming after a nine-month break, drawing millions of excited fans. His comeback stream simultaneously broadcast on Twitch and YouTube, a first for the popular streamer. The event successfully revealed the professors and students for the upcoming Streamer University 2026 program. Over one million viewers tuned in live across both platforms, showcasing his immense popularity.

stories.title: PM seeks UNSC reforms, inclusive development; Indonesia backs India’s zero-tolerance terrorism policy but stops short of naming Pak groups
Defence, port, AI: Modi, Prabowo script 'golden chapter' in ties
UK govt mulls emergency law to deport grooming gang ringleader to Pakistan
stories.summary: Labour is exploring emergency legislation to deport a grooming gang leader. Shabir Ahmed, convicted of child rape, was released after serving fourteen years. He is currently exempt from deportation due to an old immigration law. The government is considering legislative changes to address this loophole. Discussions are ongoing with Pakistan to facilitate his removal from the UK.

stories.title: Quote of the day by Michelle Obama: 'Failure is a feeling long before it becomes an actual result'
stories.summary: Quote of the day by Michelle Obama: In her 2018 memoir 'Becoming', Michelle Obama wrote about her childhood in Chicago. Her school Bryn Mawr was at the heart of her childhood and Michelle Obama's famous quote on failure came in the context of a crisis that her school was facing and how the principal resisted it.

stories.title: Heavy rains trigger flash floods in Doda, damage houses and roads
stories.summary: Torrential rainfall caused flash floods and mudslides in Thathri town early Tuesday. Several houses were buried under debris, and many vehicles were damaged or washed away. The Doda-Kishtwar highway remains blocked due to landslides, suspending vehicular traffic. Restoration teams are working to clear debris and reopen the arterial road. Authorities are monitoring the situation and assessing the extent of the damage.

stories.title: 'Terror threat plea improbable': HC rejects Cong worker’s plea to shift trial from Srinagar to Jammu
stories.summary: The High Court of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh rejected a Congress worker's plea. He sought to shift his cheque bounce trial from Srinagar to Jammu. The court stated terrorism is almost eliminated in the Valley now. It noted the petitioner's claims of threat were improbable and lacked merit. The court found the petition was filed to avoid payment and prolong proceedings.

stories.title: Before Delhi protest, NC secures Kashmir civil society’s resolution for restoration of statehood
stories.summary: The National Conference is rallying support for its upcoming July 20 protest. Party leaders met with Kashmir civil society groups on Tuesday. These groups adopted a resolution demanding the restoration of J&K's statehood. The governing NC announced this one-day protest in Delhi earlier. This demonstration coincides with Parliament's monsoon session opening.

stories.title: Chennai tops domestic flights punctuality in May, Delhi & Mumbai at bottom of 10 busiest airports: DGCA data
stories.summary: Chennai airport recorded the highest on-time domestic flight performance in May. IndiGo, Akasa, and Air India Group led airline punctuality among major airports. Domestic air travel saw over 1.5 crore passengers fly within the country last month. This represents a significant increase compared to the previous month's travel figures. Overall domestic air travel growth has remained tepid for the year.

stories.title: 'She's a nice person but made a mistake': Trump says ties with Meloni 'soured' over Iran war
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump described Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni as nice but criticized her stance. He stated her refusal to support the US in the Iran conflict soured their relationship. This dispute follows earlier claims by Trump about Meloni requesting a photograph. The Italian government has decided to stop responding to Trump's provocative social media remarks. Meloni's office also declined comment on their upcoming meeting at the NATO summit.

stories.title: Have you ever faced harm or mistreatment in India? Why US visa officers ask this question to every candidate
Manhattan high-rise evacuated as officials warn of potential collapse
Bengaluru daycare horror: Police defend arrest of whistleblower, say she was 'equal party' to abuse
stories.summary: Bengaluru Police defended the arrest of Sujatha, the whistleblower in a daycare abuse case. Investigators claim they found enough evidence to name her as an accused party. The police commissioner stated that procedures were not followed after the incidents surfaced. Evidence suggests one alleged incident may have been stage-managed by caregivers. The case involves disturbing videos of alleged toddler abuse at a Capgemini campus daycare.

stories.title: Quote of the day by Giorgia Meloni: 'If I were fascist, I would say that I am fascist. I never hide'
stories.summary: Quote of the day by Giorgia Meloni: Before becoming the PM of Italy, Meloni directly addressed a question on whether she was a fascist leader. She insisted that when she co-founded her party Brothers of Italy in 2012, the party was 'centre-right' and not fascist. "When I am something, I declare it. I never hide. If I were fascist, I would say that I am fascist. Instead, I have never spoken of fascism because I am not fascist," Meloni said.

stories.title: Third tanker hit in Strait of Hormuz in 24 hours as Qatar blames Iran, raising fears over global energy route
stories.summary: Commercial tankers faced escalating attacks in the Strait of Hormuz recently. Qatar blamed Iran for an unacceptable assault on its liquefied natural gas vessel. The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations reported three tanker incidents within 24 hours. These attacks threaten regional stability and global energy security significantly. Diplomatic efforts continue to prevent further escalation of the conflict.

stories.title: Gujarat-bound Qatari LNG vessel with 4 Indian crew hit in suspected drone attack near Hormuz
stories.summary: A Qatar-bound LNG carrier carrying four Indian crew members was struck near the Strait of Hormuz. The vessel sustained damage and its engine room caught fire following the suspected drone attack. All 29 seafarers on board, including the four Indians, were reported safe after the incident. Qatar accused Iran of targeting the vessel, calling it a violation of international law.

stories.title: Badrinath donation row: BKTC suspends employee as probe into alleged theft begins, CCTV examined
stories.summary: An employee was suspended as an inquiry panel investigates donation handling irregularities. The probe began after social media allegations surfaced regarding offerings at Badrinath Dham. CCTV footage and employee statements will be examined by the four-member committee. Questions arose about CCTV camera replacements, which officials stated was routine. The controversy has also sparked political debate and calls for further investigation.

stories.title: What is E-2 visa? Immigration attorney says you don't need to start a business from scratch
Trump announces Turkey sanctions lift at Nato summit, signals possible F-35 fighter jet sale
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump has taken a notable step by removing sanctions on Turkey and hinted at the sale of F-35 fighter jets to the nation. This move follows Turkey's acquisition of Russian air defense systems, which had led to its exclusion from the F-35 program. Trump praised Turkey for its commitment to U.S. relations, showcasing a potential realignment in diplomatic ties.

stories.title: School PGI climbs, but learning score stays frozen
'Like to sing & dance to Indian songs': Indonesian president's 'DNA' remark draws praise from PM Modi
stories.summary: Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto expressed admiration for Prime Minister Narendra Modi's governance. He acknowledged studying and adapting Indian policies for Indonesia's development. Subianto also praised India's democratic system and election process. Indonesia closely studies India's peaceful transfer of power mechanisms. These remarks were made during Prime Minister Modi's recent three-nation visit.

stories.title: PM Modi’s 'Kuch Kuch Hota Hai' moment in Indonesia & a 'bahut kuch' message for future ties
France's Marine Le Pen sentenced to house arrest, 2027 presidential bid remains uncertain
stories.summary: Marine Le Pen faces house arrest and a ban from public office after a court ruling. This sentence could impact her presidential election bid scheduled for April and May 2027. The case involves allegations of misusing European Parliament funds for fake jobs between 2004 and 2016. Le Pen denies the charges and claims the party acted in good faith.

stories.title: The mystery of 8: Why PM Modi mentioned this number in his Indonesia speech
stories.summary: Prime Minister Modi emphasized the number eight during his address to the Indian diaspora in Jakarta. He noted numerical connections between India's Republic Day and President Prabowo's birthday. The number eight holds significant cultural meaning in Indonesia, symbolizing prosperity and good fortune. This visit saw twenty agreements signed, strengthening bilateral cooperation between the nations. India will also assist in conserving the ancient Prambanan Temple, a shared heritage site.

stories.title: Candace Owens-Andrew Kolvet feud reaches boiling point over Charlie Kirk legacy fight: ‘You are a CLOWN’
stories.summary: Candace Owens and Andrew Kolvet are locked in a public feud over Charlie Kirk’s legacy and the nature of Owens’ friendship with the late TPUSA founder. After Kolvet suggested Kirk was merely “placating” her, Owens responded with a lengthy X post, calling him a “CLOWN” and a liar. The dispute has widened existing divisions within conservative circles.

stories.title: Quote of the day by Princess Diana: "I think the biggest disease the world suffers from in this day and age is…"
Scientists tried to thicken Arctic ice by pumping seawater onto it. The ice did become thicker and brighter, but there is a big catch
stories.summary: Scientists tested spraying seawater onto Arctic ice, which showed promising initial results. The treated ice became thicker and more reflective, resisting summer melting effectively. This method offers an alternative to controversial geoengineering approaches for ice preservation. While promising, researchers note significant challenges for large-scale implementation across the Arctic. Further work is essential before this technique can be considered for broader application.

stories.title: $88M LA mansion, even JLo eyed, sells for half its price
stories.summary: The Jennifer Lopez-admired Holmby Hills estate is now under contract after many years. This lavish property, formerly owned by Max Azria, had a steep price reduction. Jennifer Lopez had previously considered purchasing the grand estate on two separate occasions. The 2.8-acre compound features extensive gardens and a glass-enclosed tennis court. The deal has not yet closed, and the final sale price remains confidential.

stories.title: Can Satellites fight? Space force stages orbital war game between two spacecraft
stories.summary: Space Force recently tested satellite interception capabilities in orbit. Two commercial satellites successfully located and assessed each other during the mission. This exercise demonstrated rapid identification and inspection of other spacecraft. The US Space Force is preparing for potential future conflicts in space. Such missions are becoming crucial for broader defense planning and strategic competition.

stories.title: Quote of the day by Franklin D. Roosevelt: "Men are not prisoners of fate, but only prisoners of…"
UK court dismisses Prince Harry's privacy lawsuit against tabloid
stories.summary: Prince Harry and other celebrities lost privacy lawsuits against the Daily Mail publisher. The High Court dismissed their claims, stating unlawful information acquisition was not proven. Associated Newspapers called the verdict an overwhelming victory for its journalists. Harry has pursued multiple legal cases against British media publishers. He previously won a case against the Daily Mirror publisher.

stories.title: Buried treasure: Appalachian Mountains hold enough lithium to make 500 billion smartphones and 130 million electric vehicles, scientists discover
'Serviced vehicles not facing difficulty': Hardeep Puri rejects engine damage claims over E20 fuel
stories.summary: Hardeep Singh Puri dismissed social media claims about E20 petrol as misinterpretation. He stated that compatible vehicles and manufacturers report no significant issues. India has used E15 fuel for over three years and E20 since last April. Tests for E25 fuel are ongoing and will involve stakeholder consultations. The government defends the ethanol program for its economic and environmental benefits.

stories.title: Cough syrup, 4 calls to 'girlfriend in India': Engineer husband charged with murder 8 months after wife found dead in US home
Saudi Arabia simplifies travel with all-in-one package visa including flights, hotels and e-visa services
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia has launched a pilot Tourist Package Visa service for easier travel. This new initiative combines flights, hotels, and visa processing into one booking. The program aims to simplify travel arrangements for visitors planning trips to the Kingdom. Currently, the pilot phase is available for travelers from select countries like India and Pakistan. This integrated approach supports Saudi Arabia's ambitious Vision 2030 tourism goals.

stories.title: Evening news wrap: Close shave for Macron in Syria; Iran takes jab at US after FIFA ouster, and more
stories.summary: A deadly Wayanad landslide claimed three lives and left several missing. Siya Goyal, accused in a murder, reportedly married her alleged lover before the crime. Explosions near French President Macron's hotel in Syria wounded eighteen people. Prime Minister Modi highlighted India and Indonesia's role in the Indo-Pacific region. Iran mocked the United States after its FIFA World Cup elimination.

stories.title: Wayanad landslide: Death toll rises to 4, opposition alleges 'negligence' - top developments
stories.summary: A devastating landslide near the Wayanad tunnel construction site has claimed lives and injured several people. Rescue operations are ongoing for those still missing after the mudslide near Meenakshi Bridge. Videos captured the terrifying moments as mud and debris rushed downhill, engulfing vehicles. The state government alleges contractors ignored repeated safety warnings regarding excavated soil. Opposition leaders are calling for a thorough investigation into potential criminal negligence.

stories.title: 'Will respond point-by-point': Champat Rai says will speak after final SIT report on Ram temple funds theft row
Interpol-wanted woman in Monaco bombing case found shot dead near Kyiv; two detained
stories.summary: Anastasiia Berezovska, a Ukrainian woman linked to a bomb attack in Monaco, was discovered dead near Kyiv, having been shot. She was under an Interpol warrant for attempted murder. Authorities have detained two suspects, one of whom is an intelligence officer, in connection with her murder. The bombing had targeted a prosperous businessman from Ukraine living in Monaco, leaving him and his family injured.

stories.title: A Japan mountain trail reopened after a fatal bear attack. Hours later, another brown bear stranded four hikers
stories.summary: Four hikers were stranded on a Hokkaido mountain after encountering a brown bear. They waited for over three hours before rescue teams arrived by helicopter. The bear had blocked the trail, preventing the group from continuing their descent. This incident occurred on Mount Rausu, which had recently reopened after a fatal attack. Bear encounters are increasing across Japan, prompting official warnings.

stories.title: 5-month-old startup wants to launch 100,000 AI data centre satellites into space
'Appeal UDF to provide support': Wayanad MP Priyanka Gandhi says rescue operations in full swing amid landslide
Indian hairstylist charged with sexual abuse on a cruise docked in Seattle, offered free massages to women, then molested passengers
stories.summary: An Indian hairstylist, Pranit Pawar, is facing serious allegations of abusive sexual contact aboard a cruise ship. Accused of luring passengers into false massage offers, he allegedly proceeded to inappropriately touch victims in a confined space. The FBI has launched an investigation into the troubling incidents, which took place under US maritime jurisdiction. Pawar has confessed that his actions fell well outside his professional duties.

stories.title: America's 250-year time capsule has been buried: Here's what people in 2276 will discover
China battered by extreme weather: Floods, tornadoes & landslides kills over 20, videos capture destruction
stories.summary: Torrential rain and tornadoes killed at least twenty people across China. Over 330 others sustained injuries from extreme weather events in several provinces. A landslide in Gansu Province buried thirty-three people, with twelve still missing. Record rainfall triggered severe flooding in Guangxi, affecting over 93,000 residents. President Xi Jinping ordered all-out efforts for rescue and disaster relief operations.

stories.title: What will happen on 13 April 2029: A giant asteroid will pass closer than some satellites and be visible to billions
'Brought India, Indonesia closer': PM Modi heaps big praise on Biju Patnaik during Jakarta address
Quote of the day by Saddam Hussein: 'A lion doesn't care if a monkey in a tree is laughing at him'
Florida dad grabbed a 202-pound Burmese python, then it started dragging him towards a canal before his entire family took down the giant snake
India emerges as global hub for AI healthcare innovation
stories.summary: Over 85% of company's AI innovations are developed in India as it bets on artificial intelligence to expand access to advanced diagnostics and ease pressure on the country's healthcare system

stories.title: 'Confrontational statements' on Russia: Kremlin slams Nato's Ankara summit
stories.summary: Russia continues working-level discussions with the United States regarding Ukraine peace efforts. Kremlin spokespersons expressed hope for successful US diplomatic initiatives to achieve peace. Moscow will closely observe the outcomes of the NATO summit in Ankara. Russia noted confrontational statements made by NATO members before the meeting. The ongoing conflict in Ukraine sees fighting along multiple fronts.

stories.title: Cockroaches can survive without their heads for a week: The science behind one of nature's toughest insects
'Bridge Man of India' Girish Bharadwaj dies at 76; built 140 low-cost bridges for remote villages
Explained: The app that can stop an e-rickshaw — and why it has exposed a bigger cybersecurity risk
stories.summary: Vulnerable e-rickshaw batteries are being remotely disabled using Bluetooth apps. Government agencies have ordered app removals and initiated cybersecurity investigations. Experts state the issue lies in insecure battery system designs, not just specific applications. This vulnerability affects low-cost vehicles prioritizing affordability over digital security. The incidents highlight broader risks for connected transport systems and public safety.

stories.title: 'Stop the genocide': Baloch protesters in Germany raise alarm over Pakistan atrocities
UAE revokes Ajman's Horizon University licence over 'severe and repeated' violations; students to be transferred
stories.summary: The UAE Ministry of Higher Education revoked Horizon University College's license due to severe and repeated violations. This action immediately halts all academic activities and student admissions at the institution. The ministry is coordinating with other universities to ensure students can continue their education. Affected learners will receive support during this transition process. This move reinforces the UAE's commitment to maintaining high academic standards.

stories.title: NASA Chief says China can soon outsmart US in space exploration: But could shape the future of space
stories.summary: In an exciting twist of cosmic competition, China and the United States have sparked a modern space race aimed at lunar exploration. With NASA's Artemis program facing delays, China is quickly advancing its goals. This fierce rivalry focuses on securing lunar resources and establishing a lasting foothold on the Moon, potentially paving the way for humanity's next giant leap towards Mars.

stories.title: Why does Alaska go 65 days without sunrise: The science behind polar night
'I copy your career': Indonesia's President praises PM Modi's 'progress', banquet erupts in applause
Seconds before disaster: CCTV shows Wayanad landslide sweeping away fuel tanker; 3 dead, 7 missing
stories.summary: A landslide near Wayanad's tunnel project site caused significant destruction and panic. Two people died and seven others sustained injuries in the sudden debris flow. Several individuals remain missing after the devastating incident occurred near Meenakshi Bridge. Heavy rainfall and construction debris are under scrutiny as contributing factors. Rescue operations are ongoing to locate the missing and clear the affected area.

stories.title: Trump administration eyes tighter H-1B, green card and student visa rules; Indians could be among most affected
'My visit continues': French President Macron after close shave in Syria amid explosions near hotel
stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron continued his Syria visit after explosions near his hotel. Two blasts struck central Damascus, wounding at least eighteen people earlier on Tuesday. Macron was unharmed and proceeded with his scheduled meeting with Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa. Further details indicated two explosive devices detonated near the Four Seasons Hotel. No group has claimed responsibility for the recent attack in Damascus.

stories.title: 'India strong advocate of a free Indo-Pacific': PM Modi's strong message to China from Indonesia
stories.summary: Prime Minister Modi addressed the Indonesian Parliament, highlighting shared civilizational ties. He called for closer cooperation based on democratic values and development. Modi received Indonesia's highest civilian honor, the Bintang Adipurna. He dedicated this award to the people of India and the partnership. The Prime Minister emphasized India's developmental approach over expansionism.

stories.title: SC row fallout: From ‘corruption’ to PILs — NCERT rewrites judiciary lesson
From fake WhatsApp stock tips to bogus trading apps: List of investment scams flagged by MHA — explained
Cliff swallows abandoned the California town they once filled every spring, then people came together to rebuild their homes and welcomed them back with an annual festival
NASA’s Voyager 1 left Earth in 1977; now its signal takes over 22 hours to reach us and it is still sending data
stories.summary: Nearly 49 years after its launch, NASA's Voyager 1 continues to send data from around 25 billion kilometres away, making it the most distant human-made object in space. As its power supply slowly declines, NASA is carefully switching off onboard systems to keep the spacecraft operational. Voyager 1 is also expected to reach another milestone in 2026, when a signal from Earth will take a full 24 hours to reach it.

stories.title: Satluj removed from ZEE5: Centre to send Diljit Dosanjh's film to IT Rules committee
stories.summary: The government will examine the film Satluj via an Inter-Departmental Committee. This committee considers content grievances from digital platforms and news publishers. The film, based on Jaswant Singh Khalra, was removed from ZEE5 after its release. Authorities cited security concerns and the film's release without CBFC cuts. The committee can recommend various actions, including content deletion or blocking.

stories.title: World's first diamond to travel to space will launch aboard India's Vikram-1 rocket
Ram Temple theft row: UP CM Yogi Adityanath calls out Congress, Samajwadi Party with 'chameleon' dig
stories.summary: A day after the Ram Mandir Trust accepted the resignation of Champat Rai from the position of general secretary, Yogi accused the rival political parties, Congress and the Samajwadi Party, of "making a mockery of Hindu faith" -- the same allegation the opposition has been levelling against the BJP. Yogi futher asked why the anti-NDA bloc remained muted when hectares of land across the nation were "sold off in the name of the Wakf".

stories.title: Florida influencer DreamDoll Brii dies at 21 after shooting in Lamborghini
stories.summary: Social media influencer Brianna Johnson, known as DreamDoll Brii, died after being shot. She was traveling in a lime green Lamborghini when a white sedan opened fire. Two other individuals in the vehicle were critically injured and hospitalized. Investigators believe the attackers specifically targeted the vehicle for unknown reasons. Police are continuing their investigation and seeking public assistance for information.

stories.title: Teen footballer who went missing on 4th of July found dead
stories.summary: The body of missing footballer Nolan Wells was found off Horn Island. He vanished during Fourth of July celebrations after a boat trip with friends. Search teams combed the island and surrounding waters for the missing teenager. His family is heartbroken and seeking privacy during their grief. Authorities are investigating the cause of his untimely death.

stories.title: The ultimate UK food guide: 10 most exciting new London restaurant openings of 2026
stories.summary: London's dining scene is experiencing exciting new openings this summer. Elegant seafood spots and smoky barbecue joints are among the new arrivals. Stylish neighbourhood bistros and French brasseries also feature prominently. These diverse culinary destinations highlight the city's evolving food landscape. Visitors can explore these exciting new restaurants across various London neighbourhoods.

stories.title: 'It's like we are living in a prison in our own house': Michigan couple say nearby data centre's nonstop noise has ruined their lives
Kejriwal seeks written assurance from automakers on E20 fuel; slams Centre's 'misadventure'
stories.summary: Addressing a press conference, Kejriwal said he would write to Maruti Suzuki, Toyota Kirloskar and Hero MotoCorp, claiming their public statements on E20 fuel were inconsistent with the guidance provided in their vehicle owner manuals. He also questioned whether the companies would compensate customers if E20 fuel caused damage to vehicle components.

stories.title: Delhi HC restores CJP's X handle, says Centre's concern over NEET chaos 'no longer relevant'
Diljit Dosanjh's 'Satluj' released without certification process being completed: Centre
stories.summary: Based on the life of human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra, Satluj had been at the centre of a prolonged certification dispute before it was released on ZEE5 on Friday under a new title. The streaming platform later withdrew the film from India, saying it would remain unavailable until further notice. According to officials in the information and broadcasting ministry, the film did not have the mandatory certification required for a theatrical release before it was made available online.

stories.title: Taiwan turned shopping receipts into lottery tickets in 1951; 75 years later, people still keep every bill hoping to win millions
A Native American tribe once relied on oil and gas; now its desert land will help power Meta’s new data center
stories.summary: The Ute Mountain Ute Tribe is developing a large solar project. This initiative will supply clean energy to a new Meta data center. The project marks a significant shift from the tribe's oil and gas revenue. Renewable energy developers face policy uncertainties and permitting challenges. The tribe secured approvals before new federal regulations took effect.

stories.title: 'How can a court regulate what a CM can say?' SC dismisses DMK plea on Karur stampede case
Japan, China clash in high-stakes maritime standoff near disputed islands
stories.summary: Japan's coast guard expelled Chinese vessels from waters near disputed islands. China stated its coast guard warned and expelled an intruding Japanese fishing boat. The confrontation occurred amid already strained ties between the two Asian powers. The Senkaku-Diaoyu islands remain a major flashpoint for decades. The East China Sea region is strategically important due to proximity to Taiwan.

stories.title: PM Modi conferred with Indonesia's highest honour during his 2-day state visit
stories.summary: The Bintang Republik Indonesia Adipurna, commonly referred to as the Bintang Adipurna, is Indonesia's highest state honour. It is the highest class of the Star of the Republic of Indonesia (Bintang Republik Indonesia), the country's premier order of merit, and is conferred by the President of Indonesia on individuals who have rendered extraordinary service to the nation.

stories.title: Meet Paranthropus: The ancient human cousin that may have made the first stone tools 2.6 million years ago
Indonesia to build country-specific EVMs with India's support
stories.summary: The two countries are also expected to deepen cooperation in critical minerals. According to sources, India will invest in the manufacturing of steel, nickel and rare earth permanent magnets in Indonesia to strengthen resilient supply chains for strategic industries. Prime Minister Narendra Modi met Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto at the Istana Merdeka, the Presidential Palace in Jakarta, where the two leaders held bilateral talks after the Prime Minister signed the visitors' book.

stories.title: Ukraine launches 400+ drones at Moscow after deadly Russian strikes ahead of Nato summit
stories.summary: Ukraine launched over 400 drones at Moscow and struck Belgorod region. This offensive followed a deadly Russian missile and drone barrage across Ukraine. Ukrainian President Zelenskyy renewed his appeal for stronger Western air defense systems. He urged the United States to grant licenses for Patriot missile production. NATO leaders will discuss Ukraine's war and military assistance at their summit.

stories.title: 'No fault of Champat Rai': Ram Mandir trustee says all 'gold and silver donations safe'
stories.summary: Responding to allegations that precious offerings had gone missing, the trustee categorically rejected the claims and said every gold and silver donation remained secure. "Regarding the serious allegations that saddened many--specifically about the gold and silver donations--all the gold and silver is there, safely stored and accounted for. A full report of it has been provided. Ram Lalla has ensured all work is completed. The mistakes being shown were mostly narratives from the media. Ultimately, the media's own errors were revealed," he said.

stories.title: How E20 affects your car and what’s next on E85 rollout
stories.summary: India has now fully embraced E20 petrol, featuring a mixture of 20% ethanol. The government aims to facilitate even higher ethanol concentrations, such as E22 to E30, by waiving excise duties on these blends. Many consumers have raised concerns regarding the impact on fuel economy and older engines, but automotive manufacturers emphasize that E20 has proven safe.

stories.title: China sentences former official to death in $325 million bribery case
stories.summary: The Changzhou Intermediate People's Court in Jiangsu province said Yang accepted the illicit payments between 1993 and 2023 in return for helping individuals and companies secure projects, business opportunities, land allocations and financial support. According to the court, the bribes were paid in exchange for assistance with "undertaking projects, business operations, land grants and working capital."

stories.title: Shivaji statue removal in Goa: SC declines to entertain plea
China test fires missile into Pacific, sparks alarm
Oil tanker hit at Hormuz: US accuses Iran of attacking 2 commercial ships; mulls action
Cuba suffers third nationwide blackout in 6 months
A doctored pic of Obamas & Air Force One with graffiti
'There'll either be a deal with Iran or US will 'finish the job': Donald Trump
Clashes break out in Sri Lankan jail, 26 dead, over 100 hurt
TTP claims killing of Pakistan Air Force officer in Islamabad
"One more fight, Charlie": Candace Owens sends defiant message as Charlie Kirk family pleads for privacy at Tyler Robinson hearing
stories.summary: Tyler Robinson's preliminary hearing in the Charlie Kirk murder case began under heavy security, with the court deciding whether there is enough evidence for a trial. Charlie Kirk's widow Erika and his parents asked for privacy, calling the proceedings a painful reminder of their loss. Meanwhile, Candace Owens posted, "One more fight, Charlie. I don't fear these demons. We will win," taking a far more defiant public stance as the case continues.

stories.title: “My prayers weren’t answered”: IShowSpeed abruptly bursts into tears after Spain eliminate Portugal from FIFA World Cup
stories.summary: IShowSpeed was left heartbroken after Spain defeated Portugal 1-0 in the FIFA World Cup 2026 Round of 16. Mikel Merino scored in stoppage time to send Spain through and end Cristiano Ronaldo’s final World Cup campaign. Speed became emotional during his reaction, saying he believed Portugal would win the tournament before later thanking Ronaldo for everything.

stories.title: Indian diplomat protests wrong depiction of J&K at Dhaka seminar
stories.summary: India lodged a protest at a Dhaka seminar after a map showed Kashmir as part of Pakistan. An Indian diplomat immediately raised objections during the presentation by a former ambassador. The diplomat stated that Jammu and Kashmir is an integral part of India. The former ambassador claimed the map was for representational purposes only. The seminar was organized by the Bangladesh Institute of International and Strategic Studies.

stories.title: 2 Assam Rifles personnel killed in Manipur ambush
stories.summary: Two Assam Rifles personnel died after suspected militants ambushed their vehicle. The attack occurred on NH-202 in Manipur's Ukhrul district on Monday afternoon. Security forces responded quickly and engaged in an exchange of fire with the assailants. Further operations are currently underway to apprehend the individuals responsible for the incident. The deceased soldiers were identified as Warrant Officer Balwant Singh and Constable CM Singh.

stories.title: ARAI report found E20 fuel may damage rubber parts in E10 vehicles, engine durability tests carried out for 400-806 hrs
stories.summary: An ARAI report noted rubber part deterioration in E10 vehicles using E20 fuel. Metallic components showed no adverse impact, and emissions remained within legislative limits. One BS-VI turbocharged engine experienced issues after durability testing, unlike a BS-IV engine. Two-wheeler engine durability tests showed acceptable performance with E20 fuel. Fuel consumption increased by two to six percent for vehicles using E20.

stories.title: NIA charges LeT chief Hafiz Saeed with plotting Pahalgam terror strike
stories.summary: The National Investigation Agency has charged Hafiz Saeed for the Pahalgam attack. This attack tragically killed twenty-five tourists and one local resident. Evidence includes digital trails and on-ground examination by the agency. Saeed, LeT chief, faces charges under new Indian penal codes. He will be tried in absentia for waging war against India.

stories.title: Govt gives WhatsApp 3 more days to reply to notice on username
Govt got 'Satluj' pulled off OTT on security grounds
stories.summary: The government asked ZEE5 to remove the film 'Satluj' citing security concerns. This action followed the movie's release on the OTT platform after a long delay. The film depicts the story of activist Jaswant Singh Khalra and his disappearance. Its makers released the movie on ZEE5 with a new name after censor objections. Families of victims oppose the ban, believing the film acknowledges a painful history.

stories.title: Nabin's simplicity reflects BJP's values, says Modi
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi publicly supported BJP president Nitin Nabin. He highlighted Nabin's simplicity as a source of pride for party members. This defense followed mocking remarks from Telangana CM Revanth Reddy and Arvind Kejriwal. Nabin, a former Bihar MLA, faced criticism for his relative lack of national recognition. Modi cited schoolmate accounts of Nabin's modest lifestyle during his Delhi college days.

stories.title: PM: Mookerjee ensured Bengal remained integral part of India
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi honored Syama Prasad Mookerjee's legacy in Kolkata. He highlighted Mookerjee's efforts to keep Bengal united with India during partition. Mookerjee's industrial vision established key national institutions for economic strength. The Prime Minister noted Mookerjee's opposition to separate constitutions and flags. His government fulfilled Mookerjee's dream by removing Article 370.

stories.title: Defence, critical minerals on agenda as Modi arrives in Indonesia
stories.summary: Prime Minister Modi began a three-nation tour in Jakarta, Indonesia. He will meet President Prabowo Subianto for bilateral cooperation talks. Discussions will cover trade, defense, and critical minerals like nickel. The visit aims to deepen civilizational ties and people-to-people connections. Modi will then travel to Australia and New Zealand for further strategic engagements.

stories.title: Government to form cooperative life insurance company: Amit Shah
'Resigned judge' can't be impeached, say constitutional experts
stories.summary: Parliament will table an inquiry report on former judge Yashwant Varma's removal. Justice Varma resigned in April after facing allegations of unaccounted money. Constitutional experts state impeachment proceedings are now pointless after his resignation. They emphasize a judge ceases to hold office upon resignation, not requiring acceptance. The report's tabling is seen as a political formality with no effective purpose.

stories.title: Finnish proverb of the day: "The forest answers in the same way one shouts at it" teaches us that we get what we do to others
Bengal girl was ga﻿ng-raped, brutalised, shows autopsy
stories.summary: A 12-year-old girl was sexually abused and brutally murdered in Baruipur. Her body was found in a local pond after she was dumped alive. The autopsy report indicated horrific injuries and suffocation as the cause of death. Police have charged three suspects under severe sections of the law. The Chief Minister vowed to seek capital punishment for all accused.

stories.title: Kick Streamer Raja Jackson jailed following Kick livestream attack on wrestler Syko Stu
stories.summary: Kick streamer Raja Jackson has begun a ninety-day jail sentence for assaulting wrestler Syko Stu. The attack occurred during a live Kick broadcast in August of last year. Jackson must also pay eighty-one thousand dollars in restitution to Syko Stu. Syko Stu suffered severe injuries but has forgiven Jackson for the incident. The streamer will also serve two years of formal probation following his release.

stories.title: Best proverb of the day: 'The ocean keeps every secret, but charges salt for storage'
stories.summary: The ocean stands as a vast archive, modifying its essence with every new element it encounters. This mirrors the way human memory and organizational structures evolve through absorbed experiences. Current scientific findings reveal rising carbon dioxide levels are reshaping ocean chemistry, leading to acidification. Moreover, relentless plastic pollution has invaded even the most secluded oceanic depths. Similarly, digital records and unresolved disputes in workplaces exemplify transformation in our lives.

stories.title: Govt proposes 3-year window for keeping vehicles in another state
F1 visa rejected on 214(b)? Former visa officer explains what to do now, before applying for it again
Ram Temple ex-trustee Mishra failed to secure donations: SIT
stories.summary: A preliminary SIT report details alleged embezzlement of Ram temple donations. Senior Trust functionary Anil Mishra's oversight failure enabled suspects to pilfer funds. Nearly seventy instances of alleged pilferage were captured on CCTV footage. Subhash Srivastava, the counting room in charge, also faces serious lapses. The report names six suspects involved in theft and misappropriation offenses.

stories.title: Best proverb of the day: 'Even the sun negotiates with dust to make a shadow'
stories.summary: In every interaction, we witness the emergence of powerful forces, impressively reshaping themselves through their engagements with smaller components. Just as the sun interacts with dust to cast a distinct shadow, we see this dynamic at play in modern systems such as AI and workplaces. This principle underlines how constraints can nurture creativity and organizational structure, while personal identity emerges through the natural friction of experiences.

stories.title: Less than 30% of Earth’s ocean floor has been mapped while scientists still have clearer high-resolution data of Mars than most of the seabed covering our own planet
stories.summary: Despite the vastness of Earth's oceans, only about thirty percent of the seafloor is charted to modern specifications, revealing a stark difference with Mars, whose surface boasts complete mapping. The Seabed 2030 initiative has dramatically improved ocean coverage from six to nearly twenty-nine percent. This meticulous mapping relies on ships and sonar, a time-intensive endeavor crucial for effective tsunami predictions and maintaining submarine cables.

stories.title: Who was TikTok star itgirlbri? Influencer dies after targeted Miramar shooting
stories.summary: TikTok influencer itgirlbri died following a targeted drive-by shooting in Florida. She was one of three people inside a Lamborghini SUV which came under gunfire. The vehicle was reportedly leaving an Airbnb party early on July 5. Police believe the Lamborghini was deliberately targeted by a white BMW. Authorities are actively searching for the suspects and the vehicle involved.

stories.title: What did Sneako say about New York? Controversial remarks lead to deportation calls from Alex Jones
stories.summary: Sneako sparked controversy after a New York livestream in which he made comments about Islam and the future of the city. The clip spread widely on X and drew criticism from several public figures. Alex Jones called for the streamer’s deportation, while Gad Saad raised concerns about the scene shown in the video, further intensifying the online debate.

stories.title: Why was Kaceytron banned on Twitch? Streamer's channel goes offline amid suspension
stories.summary: Kaceytron's Twitch channel is currently offline due to an unexplained suspension. The platform has not revealed the specific guideline violation which led to this action. Online speculation points to a recent livestream where she was allegedly driving while intoxicated. Another theory suggests potential copyright infringement issues from past broadcasts. This marks Kaceytron's second known suspension from the streaming platform.

stories.title: New rural employment scheme prioritises water security works
stories.summary: The new VB-G RAM G rural employment scheme prioritizes water security and disaster mitigation. This initiative aims to address potential El Nino-triggered rain deficiency situations. Gram panchayats can undertake projects for disaster preparedness and climate change challenges. States facing rainfall deficits must strengthen water conservation and prepare for employment generation. The scheme also focuses on core rural infrastructure and rural livelihoods.

stories.title: ‘Participation fatigue’ a growing concern for Gram Sabhas, says study
stories.summary: A new study highlights Gram Sabha participation fatigue, driven by unresolved grievances and lack of visible outcomes. Livelihood and time constraints significantly hinder public engagement in these local meetings. The report suggests launching awareness missions and livelihood-sensitive scheduling for better participation. Strengthening inclusive platforms will improve representation of women and vulnerable groups. The ministry will implement recommendations to make Gram Sabhas more effective.

stories.title: In 1847, a Vienna doctor discovered that handwashing with chlorine could cut childbirth deaths by 90 percent, but the medical world refused to believe him
stories.summary: In a radical move, Ignaz Semmelweis mandated handwashing in hospitals, drastically reducing maternal mortality rates. Despite evidence supporting his approach, he faced fierce opposition from fellow medical professionals, as he couldn't provide a scientific rationale for his findings. Much later, the establishment of germ theory validated his revolutionary work, leading to fundamental changes in medical practices that ultimately saved innumerable lives.

stories.title: Non-state actors from outside India overwhelming Kuki areas in Manipur, adding to violence: Ex-UNLF chief
stories.summary: Former UNLF chairman Rajkumar Meghen is in Delhi seeking a coalition for peace. He urges economic integration between Kuki and Meitei communities to build trust. Meghen suggests external forces are involved in the ongoing violence in the state. He claims the government has failed to build confidence and stop the conflict. The violence has displaced thousands and claimed many lives since May 2023.

stories.title: Pak drone spotted over LoC in J&K’s Rajouri, search op launched
stories.summary: Security forces launched a search operation after a Pakistani drone was spotted near the LoC. Blinking lights were observed over Mahadev Menka and Beripattan villages late Sunday. The suspected unmanned aerial vehicle briefly entered Indian airspace before returning towards Pakistan. Forces cordoned off the area and initiated a dawn search for any dropped payloads. No suspicious items were found during the extensive search operation.

stories.title: J&K police search Samagra Shiksha office in Jammu, Noida publisher over ‘anti-national’ books
stories.summary: Police searched offices in Jammu and Noida as a probe into controversial books widened. Investigators are examining how inappropriate content reached government school libraries. Officials suspended eight education personnel after the books were withdrawn from circulation. The administration registered a case under stringent anti-terror laws. This action ignited a political row and discussions on censorship.

stories.title: Nasa’s Hubble captures a spectacular cluster of 500,000 ancient stars to mark America's 250th anniversary
What really happened between Jack Doherty and Lil Tjay? Livestream fight explained
stories.summary: What started as friendly banter between Jack Doherty and Lil Tjay during a Fourth of July Kick livestream quickly turned into a heated confrontation. Tensions rose over comments involving a watch, a chain and personal remarks about homes. Lil Tjay slapped Doherty first, and Doherty later appeared to slap him back before security intervened and the livestream suddenly ended.
